General
  1. Yimasu's Hidden Tournament 2 is an International, 2v2, teamsize 3 tournament with a minimum of 2 players per team.
  2. Players must be between 20,000-99,999BWS when registrations close. There is no rank buffer.
    1. BWS formula = global_rank^(0.9937^(badge_count^2))
  3. All times mentioned via official means are in UTC+0.
  4. All maps are played with Team VS, Score V2 and No Fail.
  5. All maps in the tournament are played with the Hidden modification enabled.
  6. There are no set parameters for mappools in this tournament outside of the amount of maps. The amount of alloted slots per mod combination may vary from week to week.
    1. Use the previous iteration as reference.
  7. You're expected to follow osu! community guidelines at all times.
Qualifiers
  1. All maps will be played with HeadToHead, Score V2, NoFail and Hidden enabled.
  2. A minimum of 2 players must be present for each map.
  3. Maps will be played from HD1 - HDM4.
  4. Teams have 90 seconds between maps to ready up. The referee will !mp start 5/10, 15 seconds after the timer runs out.
  5. If a team is 5 minutes late to their qualifier lobby, they will have to reschedule.
  6. Seeding will be calculated in Zipf's Law.
Bracket
  1. Each captain will be pinged 15 minutes before the lobby is created, and invited 5 minutes before the lobby time.
    1. Each team has 5 minutes to enter the lobby after the scheduled time. If they fail to do so, they lose their protect and all bans.
    2. If a team is still not present 10 minutes after the original lobby start time, they will automatically FF the match.
  2. Warm ups are allowed.
  3. Once both captains are present in the lobby, they will do !roll to determine protect/ban/pick order.
    1. The higher roll chooses between 1st protect/2nd ban/1st pick or 2nd protect/1st ban/2nd pick. The remaining option goes to the roll loser.
  4. Protects, Bans and Picks will have a 90/120 second timer.
  5. Each team will have 90/120 seconds to ready up.
  6. Double picks and Double bans are entirely allowed.
  7. Ban order is ABBA.
These rules are a brief overview of the full rules. Please check out the Rules Document for more in-depth information.

  6. QuarterFinals » November 28th - November 29th

  7. SemiFinals » December 5th - December 6th
    • 7 HD / 9 HDM / 1 TB
      Bans: 2 || Best of 11 || 6.3★ || 17 maps total
  8. Finals » December 12th - December 13th
    • 8 HD / 10 HDM / 1 TB
